buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The

Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. le, the exact sizes / measurements / size distribution will be intimated by the Buyer to the successful bidder after i ssue of Contract Award. The bidder shall supply the item s strictly as per the sizes so communicated. Any deviatio n from the communicated sizes shall be treated as non-c ompliance. 6- Warranty Period: The supplied material shall be cov ered under warranty for a period of 12 months from the date of supply. 7- Rejected Items: If the rejected items are not lifted w ithin 30 days, no claim in respect of such items shall be entertained thereafter. 8- Taxes and Duties: All taxes and duties including Toll Tax, Entry Tax, Octroi, and Local Taxes, if applicable, sha ll be included in the quoted basic rate. The Buyer shall n ot pay these taxes separately. 9- Imported Products: In case of imported products, th e OEM or its authorized Indian representative must have a registered office in India with adequate after-sales serv ice facilities. A certificate to this effect must be submitte d along with the bid. 10- EMD Submission: ● All bidders must submit an EMD of 3% of the bid val ue in the form of an Account Payee Demand Draft/ Fi xed Deposit Receipt (FDR) in favour of “REGIONAL DI RECTOR, SAI NSRC”, payable at Lucknow. ● A scanned copy of the DD/FDR must be uploaded wi th the bid. ● The original hard copy must be delivered to the Buy er before the bid closing/opening date. 11- Performance Security: The successful bidder shall submit a Performance Security equivalent to 5% of the c

ontract value within 15 days from the date of award of th e contract, in the form of an Account Payee Demand Dra ft or Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) in favour of “REGIONAL DIRECTOR, SAI NSRC”, payable at Lucknow. Failure to su bmit the Performance Security within the stipulated peri od may result in cancellation of the contract. 12- Sample Clause: The successful bidder shall submit the required sample(s) for buyer’s approval free of cost within 7 days from the date of issue of the Contra ct Award. The buyer shall approve the sample(s) or suggest modifi cations within 5 working days of receipt of the sample( s).The seller shall supply the material strictly as per the approved sample(s). Major deviations from the approved samples may result i n a demand for fresh sample(s) or termination of the con tract. Any delay in approval by the Buyer shall result in a corre sponding extension of the delivery schedule without im position of Liquidated Damages(LD). In case of rejection of the sample(s), the cost of any pre- approval bulk protection shall be borne by the seller. The free sample(s) provided for approval shall not form part of the contracted/supplier quantity. The free sample(s) shall become the property of SAI RC, Lucknow, and shall not be returned to the supplier. 13.Item-wise Manufacturer Status In case the bidder claims self-manufacturing of an y quoted item, the bidder shall be the actual manufa cturer of that specific item. Being a manufacturer of

one or more other items shall not qualify the bidder as t he manufacturer of the remaining items quoted. 14. Trademark/Brand Ownership Where the bidder quotes an item under its own brand, the bidder shall submit a valid Trademark Registratio n Certificate/documentary proof of trademark or b rand ownership for the quoted brand. The brand name quoted in the bid shall correspond with the trademark/brand ownership documents submitted b y the bidder. 15. Item -wise Manufacturing Proof and Verficatio n In case the bidder claims self-manufacturing of an y quoted item, the bidder shall submitted item-wise d ocumentary evidence of manufacturing capability for each such item quoted. The Purchaser reserves the right to verify the manufactu ring facility and production capability through physical i nspection before or at any stage of technical eval uation, as deemed necessary. 16. No Re-labelling/ Re- badging Re-labelling, re-badging, or affixing the bidder’s b rand/level on a third party product shall not permi tted where the bidder claims the product as self- manfactured. Any false claim or misrepresentation regarding the manu facturing status or brand ownership, if established, shall result in rejection of the concerned item and further action as per applicable rules, including debartment/bl acklisting, wherever applicable.

. 14. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 15. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 16.
